description: Identifier check-digit validator — Validate and identify codes offline: ISIN, CUSIP, SEDOL, LEI, ABA routing number, ISBN-10/13, ISSN, EAN-8/UPC-A/EAN-13/GTIN-14, IMEI, NPI, VIN and ICCID. Auto-detects the type (or pass type=), checks format and check digit, returns the expected check digit when wrong, and conversions (CUSIP to ISIN, ISBN-10 to ISBN-13, ISSN to EAN-13, GTIN-14 padding), plus parts such as ISIN country, Fed district for routing numbers and VIN model-year candidates. Structure only; does not confirm the code is issued or active. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_id_check
